beta.notes:
• Import from FortiClient: reads your existing FortiClient IPsec connection (gateway, Local ID, username, proposals, DH, lifetimes, PFS, networks)
• Pick a connection, review it, type the pre-shared key and password once (FortiClient keeps them encrypted)
• Import… also accepts FortiClient XML/backup files
• Clear warnings for settings that can't be carried over; nothing in FortiClient is changed
